dedupe_keys.name: plan4res public dataset for case study 1 part mim 1 time series used for multi modal investment pathway modelling

description: Dieter Most publishes the plan4res public time-series dataset for Case Study 1, Part MIM-1, supporting multimodal energy-investment pathway modelling. The bundle describes reference year 2015 in the EU33 modelling zone hierarchy. CSV files include industrial heat demand, passenger-car travel and home-charging availability, exogenous electricity demand, regional building heating and cooling, and renewable generation profiles. An additional offshore-wind profile transforms the 2015 basis to represent potential future capacity factors. A zone-hierarchy file describes the geographical aggregation. The source states that profiles use arbitrary units and are normalised so either their annual maximum or annual integral equals one. Zenodo offers the single ZIP archive freely under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is that the inspected metadata does not state the time-step duration, and normalised values are not absolute demands or energy outputs. The related plan4res Case Study 3 resource serves a different documented case; no interchangeability is asserted.
